summary: Approve the supplied CR3a candidate; no blocking architecture or specification defect found. Exception-path recovery coverage remains incomplete.

Reviewed the complete candidate attachment through next_offset=null, SHA-256 7d8a1154d5aedd51898536b3d6b5b6d2727949f90f8be0276ff95d83c8b46280.

Standards findings

No blocking findings. src/ergora/reference_executor.py:55 keeps verification orchestration local and calls the existing scope harness without duplicating its algorithm. At line 94, other stages delegate to the original executor. Trusted commands, artifact publication and receipt construction retain their inherited owners. The small execute wrapper is justified by the frozen executor’s lack of a verification hook.

Spec findings

No blocking findings in the supplied implementation. src/ergora/reference_executor.py:57 compares the published task’s unwrapped spec with the stage spec and writes a separate legacy projection. Lines 66–79 recompute into a fresh output path, compare/publish the full report, and use the stable persistent report path for normal FAIL detail. This addresses TV-SP1 without accepting saved PASS headers alone. Lines 80–107 preserve command-set comparison, required checks, failure handling and fence-based cancellation classification.

Nonblocking coverage suggestion — src/ergora/reference_executor.py:75 and tests/test_reference_executor.py:29. The added recovery regression exercises normal protected-path failure, while launch failure, missing output and timeout take different exception paths. If execution is interrupted after their error artifact is published, retry stability is not established by the supplied regression. Add focused cases that repeat the same failure before receipt publication and verify identical error artifacts and receipts.

Evidence limits: I did not execute tests. The attachment omits implementations of read/write, unwrap and sandbox command recovery, so their contracts were not independently audited. It also cannot establish the claimed 283-file freeze or final installed-package identities. Supplied timings do not establish a performance improvement. The wrapper fixture demonstrates the verification projection seam; it does not demonstrate public v2 admission or a complete formal v2 run.
